issues.description: Lecture constructor signature is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML specifies a constructor initializing five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order, but the template currently declares `public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents)` with only three parameters. Students must change the provided signature to satisfy the stated requirements/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template constructor declaration to `public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors)` (matching the UML order) and adjust the body accordingly.
